example.pt: Recentemente, ela mudou de emprego.

example.en: Lately I've been sleeping very badly.

example.pt: Agradeço de antemão pela ajuda.
example.en: Thank you in advance for your help.

example.en: The final deadline for registration is Friday.

example.en: We are behind schedule.

example.en: The movie is about to start.

example.pt: Mal cheguei em casa, começou a chover.
example.en: No sooner had I got home than it started to rain.
